content.title: Red Lions edge Blue Sharks in extra-time thriller
paragraphs: Red Lions beat Blue Sharks 3-2 after extra time in a match that swung back and forth from start to finish. Fox opened the scoring in the 28th minute from Lane’s assist, Gray levelled in the 62nd from Frost’s pass, Reid put Red Lions back ahead in the 95th from Rook’s assist, and Cruz made it 2-2 in the 105th with Wells involved before Red Lions went in front for good in the 113th through an own goal by Bell.

Red Lions controlled the game for long stretches, finishing with 85 field tilt, 69 possession, 776 completed passes at 93 accuracy, and 110 entries into the final third. Blue Sharks still stayed close enough to force extra-time pressure, but they were well behind in the numbers with 15 field tilt, 31 possession, and 321 completed passes at 85 accuracy, while Red Lions also led on shots, 27 to 15, shots on target, 11 to 7, and big chances, 6 to 5.

The closing spell was chaotic, and the last 10 minutes were completely tilted toward Red Lions, who had 91 field tilt and 79 possession in that stretch. Bell’s own goal in the 113th minute was the decisive moment, and Red Lions saw out the final stages from there.

draft.title: Red Lions edge a wild extra-time thriller
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that swung back and forth all night. Fox put Red Lions ahead in the 28th minute from Lane’s assist, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd from Frost’s pass, and Reid restored the lead in the 95th from Rook’s assist. Blue Sharks hit back through Cruz in the 105th with Wells involved, before Bell’s own goal in the 113th settled it for Red Lions.

Red Lions controlled the match for long spells, finishing with 85 final-third share, 69 possession, and 776 completed passes at 93 accuracy. Blue Sharks stayed in it by being direct and efficient at key moments, but Red Lions created more throughout, with 27 shots to 15, 11 on target to 7, and 6 big chances to 5.

The turning point came in the closing stretch of extra time, when Red Lions kept pinning Blue Sharks deep and forced the decisive mistake. The last 10 minutes were chaotic, but Red Lions had almost all the ball and territory, and that pressure finally told.

problems: “Blue Sharks stayed in it by being direct and efficient at key moments” is not supported and “efficient” is contradicted by their finishing_vs_xg of -0.48, which is below zero.

“The last 10 minutes were chaotic, but Red Lions had almost all the ball and territory” is too strong on the territory claim: the facts support 79% possession and 91% field tilt in the last 10 minutes, not literally “almost all” of both.
“The turning point came in the closing stretch of extra time” is an unsupported interpretation presented as fact; the facts show the match state, but not a verified turning point.
